name: @spark-match/backend
description: Spark Match backend - serverless DDD+EDA on AWS Lambda with TypeScript (Node.js)

scripts.layer:build:all: npm run layer:build:node-shared && npm run layer:build:node-runtime
scripts.migrate:create: node-pg-migrate create --use-glob --migration-file-language sql --migrations-table spark_match_migrations --migrations-schema public --schema public -- --helper false
scripts.migrate:up: node-pg-migrate up --use-glob --migration-file-language sql --migrations-table spark_match_migrations --migrations-schema public --schema public
scripts.migrate:down: node-pg-migrate down --use-glob --migration-file-language sql --migrations-table spark_match_migrations --migrations-schema public --schema public
scripts.migrate:redo: node-pg-migrate redo --use-glob --migration-file-language sql --migrations-table spark_match_migrations --migrations-schema public --schema public
scripts.migrate:status: node-pg-migrate status --use-glob --migration-file-language sql --migrations-table spark_match_migrations --migrations-schema public --schema public
